proxy-how-use.环境配置1: 1.Proxy Configuration: It is recommended to install the browser plugin (such as SwitchyOmega).
proxy-how-use.环境配置2: 2.Address Setting: Set the proxy server address to 127.0.0.1 and the port to 17890.
proxy-how-use.环境配置3: 3.HTTPS Decryption: If you need to parse HTTPS traffic, click [Get CA Certificate] and complete the trust installation in the system or browser.
proxy-how-use.拦截与篡改1: 1.Status Description: The intercept function is disabled by default. After enabling, requests matching the rules will be added to the intercept list.
proxy-how-use.拦截与篡改2: 2.View Details: Click on the list item to view and modify the request body (Header/Body) in real time.
proxy-how-use.拦截与篡改3: 3.Release Control: After modification, click [Release Current] or [Release All] to restore request sending.
proxy-how-use.历史记录与AI分析1: 1.Traffic Capture: Automatically record all HTTP/HTTPS requests sent through the proxy.
proxy-how-use.历史记录与AI分析2: 2.Resend and Edit: Support for secondary editing of historical requests and manual [Resend], results will be added to the end of the list.
proxy-how-use.历史记录与AI分析3: 3.Intelligent Analysis: Click the [Analyze] button to send the report to the AI Agent or use the built-in AI to extract key information.
proxy-how-use.代理策略管理1: 1.Intercept Rules: Support custom configuration of intercept filtering rules (based on URL, method, etc.).
proxy-how-use.代理策略管理2: 2.Timeout Mechanism: The default timeout time is 300,000ms (5 minutes). After timeout, requests will be automatically released to prevent link blocking.
proxy-how-use.代理策略管理3: 3.Global Control: You can switch to the “All Intercept” mode to capture all traffic sent through the proxy.

baseline/cors/allow-https-downgrade.describe: CORS Configuration Error: HTTPS page allows downgrade to HTTP resources
baseline/cors/allow-https-downgrade.fixedSuggestion: Ensure all cross-origin requests are made over HTTPS, strictly configure Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and avoid mixed content issues.

baseline/cors/allow-null-with-credential.describe: CORS Configuration Error: Allows 'null' origin with credentials
baseline/cors/allow-null-with-credential.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit setting Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to true when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is 'null'.

baseline/cors/any-origin-with-credential.describe: CORS Configuration Error: Allows any origin with credentials
baseline/cors/any-origin-with-credential.fixedSuggestion: When Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is true, Access-Control-Allow-Origin cannot be '*', and a specific domain must be specified.

baseline/cors/reflected.describe: CORS Configuration Error: Origin header reflection
baseline/cors/reflected.fixedSuggestion: Do not blindly reflect the Origin header from the request directly into the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header. Use whitelist validation instead.

baseline/sensitive/server-error.describe: Sensitive Information Disclosure: Server error information
baseline/sensitive/server-error.fixedSuggestion: Disable detailed error display in production environments, configure a unified error page, and avoid disclosing server version, paths, or stack information.

brute-force/basic-auth/default.describe: Weak Password Risk: HTTP Basic Authentication
brute-force/basic-auth/default.fixedSuggestion: Change default passwords, use strong password policies, and implement brute-force protection (e.g., limit attempt counts).

brute-force/form-brute/default.describe: Weak Password Risk: Form brute-force attack
brute-force/form-brute/default.fixedSuggestion: Add CAPTCHA, implement account lockout policies, and enforce high-strength passwords.

cmd-injection/template/default.fixedSuggestion: Strictly filter user input, avoid directly concatenating user-controllable data in template engines, and use sandbox environments.

crlf-injection/crlf-injection/default.fixedSuggestion: Filter line break characters (CR and LF) from user input and avoid writing them directly into HTTP response headers.

dirscan/admin/default.describe: Directory Traversal: Generic admin panel exposure
dirscan/admin/default.fixedSuggestion: Modify default admin paths, restrict admin access IPs, and add strong authentication mechanisms.

dirscan/admin/phpmyadmin.describe: Sensitive Directory: phpMyAdmin admin panel exposure
dirscan/admin/phpmyadmin.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit direct public network access to phpMyAdmin, restrict access IPs, or use HTTP Basic authentication for secondary verification.

dirscan/admin/resin.describe: Sensitive Directory: Resin management console exposure
dirscan/admin/resin.fixedSuggestion: Delete or restrict access to the Resin default management console.

dirscan/admin/solr.describe: Sensitive Directory: Solr management console exposure
dirscan/admin/solr.fixedSuggestion: Configure Solr access control lists and prohibit unauthorized access to management interfaces.

dirscan/admin/tomcat.describe: Sensitive Directory: Tomcat admin panel exposure
dirscan/admin/tomcat.fixedSuggestion: Delete the Tomcat default manager application, or modify tomcat-users.xml to set strong passwords and restrict IPs.

dirscan/admin/zabbix.describe: Sensitive Directory: Zabbix monitoring system exposure
dirscan/admin/zabbix.fixedSuggestion: Ensure Zabbix uses strong passwords, update patches promptly, and avoid exposure on public networks.

dirscan/backup/code.describe: Sensitive File: Source code backup disclosure
dirscan/backup/code.fixedSuggestion: Delete source code backup files in web directories (such as .zip, .tar.gz, .bak, etc.) and prohibit web servers from accessing such extensions.

dirscan/backup/default.describe: Sensitive File: Generic backup file disclosure
dirscan/backup/default.fixedSuggestion: Regularly clean up temporary and backup files in web directories, and configure servers to prohibit downloading backup format files.

dirscan/backup/sql.describe: Sensitive File: Database SQL backup disclosure
dirscan/backup/sql.fixedSuggestion: Strictly prohibit placing .sql database backup files in web root directories. Store them in non-web accessible paths.

dirscan/code/git.fixedSuggestion: Delete .git directories in production environments, or configure web servers (Nginx/Apache) to prohibit access to .git paths.

dirscan/code/svn.fixedSuggestion: Delete .svn directories in production environments, or configure web servers to prohibit access to .svn paths.

dirscan/config/database.describe: Sensitive File: Database configuration file disclosure
dirscan/config/database.fixedSuggestion: Move configuration files out of web root directories, or configure web servers to prohibit access to configuration files such as .conf, .ini, .yml.

dirscan/config/default.describe: Sensitive File: Generic configuration file disclosure
dirscan/config/default.fixedSuggestion: Inspect and protect all configuration files, ensure permissions are set to owner-read-only, and prevent direct web downloads.

dirscan/config/dependence.describe: Information Disclosure: Dependency configuration files (e.g., package.json, composer.json)
dirscan/config/dependence.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit access to project dependency description files to avoid disclosing component version information that could lead to exploitation of known vulnerabilities.

dirscan/config/exec.describe: Sensitive File: Executable configuration file disclosure
dirscan/config/exec.fixedSuggestion: Ensure configuration files cannot be executed or downloaded, and restrict web directory execution permissions.

dirscan/config/htaccess.fixedSuggestion: Configure web servers to prohibit access to .htaccess files (Apache typically prohibits this by default, but configuration should be verified).

dirscan/config/htpasswd.fixedSuggestion: Strictly prohibit placing .htpasswd files in web-accessible directories and ensure their permissions are strictly controlled.

dirscan/config/ide.describe: Sensitive File: IDE project configuration disclosure (.idea, .vscode)
dirscan/config/ide.fixedSuggestion: Clean up IDE configuration files in projects after development completion, and configure servers to prohibit access to such directories.

dirscan/config/pac.describe: Sensitive File: PAC proxy configuration file disclosure
dirscan/config/pac.fixedSuggestion: Evaluate whether PAC files contain sensitive internal network addresses, and do not publish them unless necessary.

dirscan/config/sensitive.describe: Sensitive File: Configuration file containing sensitive information
dirscan/config/sensitive.fixedSuggestion: Scan and encrypt or remove sensitive information (such as API Key, Secret Key) from configuration files.

dirscan/config/sftp.describe: Sensitive File: SFTP/FTP configuration file disclosure
dirscan/config/sftp.fixedSuggestion: Delete FTP client configuration files in web directories (such as sftp-config.json).

dirscan/config/web.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit web access to the server's own configuration files.

dirscan/debug/default.fixedSuggestion: Debug mode (Debug Mode) must be disabled in production environments to avoid disclosing environment information.

dirscan/debug/php.fixedSuggestion: Delete phpinfo() pages or probe files in production environments.

dirscan/debug/readme.fixedSuggestion: It is recommended to delete or prohibit access to documentation files such as README.md to avoid disclosing software version information.

dirscan/directory/backup.fixedSuggestion: Disable the directory listing (Directory Listing) feature of web servers and remove backup directories.

dirscan/directory/default.describe: Directory Traversal: Default directory listing enabled
dirscan/directory/default.fixedSuggestion: Disable directory browsing functionality (Options -Indexes) in web server configuration.

dirscan/directory/files.fixedSuggestion: Ensure file upload or storage directories do not enable directory traversal permissions.

dirscan/directory/help.fixedSuggestion: Remove unnecessary help documentation systems to prevent version information disclosure or exploitation for social engineering.

dirscan/directory/logs.fixedSuggestion: Move log directories out of web root directories and strictly restrict access permissions.

dirscan/directory/source.describe: Directory Traversal: Source code directory exposure
dirscan/directory/source.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit direct access to source code directories and ensure only compiled files or entry point files are accessible.

dirscan/dynamic-backup/default.describe: Sensitive File: Dynamic script backup (.php.bak, etc.)
dirscan/dynamic-backup/default.fixedSuggestion: Configure servers to parse or prohibit access to files with extensions such as .bak, .swp to prevent source code from being downloaded in text format.

dirscan/sensitive/crossdomain.describe: Configuration Error: crossdomain.xml configuration too permissive
dirscan/sensitive/crossdomain.fixedSuggestion: Restrict the 'allow-access-from' domain in crossdomain.xml and avoid setting it to '*'.

dirscan/sensitive/statistic.describe: Sensitive Information: Traffic statistics admin panel disclosure
dirscan/sensitive/statistic.fixedSuggestion: Restrict access permissions to statistics systems and set strong password protection.

dirscan/sensitive/upload.describe: Security Risk: Upload directory permission misconfiguration
dirscan/sensitive/upload.fixedSuggestion: Upload directories should prohibit script execution permissions (e.g., prohibit PHP/JSP execution) and only allow static file access.

dirscan/sourcemap/default.describe: Source Code Disclosure: Frontend SourceMap file exposure
dirscan/sourcemap/default.fixedSuggestion: Disable SourceMap generation during production builds, or prohibit .map files from being accessed via public networks to prevent frontend code restoration.

dirscan/system/config.fixedSuggestion: Ensure web users have no access to system-level configuration files.

dirscan/system/core.describe: System Risk: Core Dump file disclosure
dirscan/system/core.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit web access to core dump files and configure the system to store Core Dumps in non-web directories.

dirscan/system/default.describe: System Risk: Default system file disclosure
dirscan/system/default.fixedSuggestion: Clean up system-generated files remaining in web root directories.

dirscan/system/history.fixedSuggestion: Strictly prohibit using user home directories as web root directories and prohibit access to .*history files.

dirscan/system/key.describe: Sensitive File: Private key/certificate file disclosure
dirscan/system/key.fixedSuggestion: Strictly prohibit placing certificate private key files such as .key, .pem, .p12 in web directories.

dirscan/system/log.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit web access to system log files.

dirscan/system/password.describe: Sensitive File: Password information disclosure (/etc/passwd, etc.)
dirscan/system/password.fixedSuggestion: Check for arbitrary file read vulnerabilities and strictly control web process permissions.

dirscan/system/pubkey.describe: Sensitive File: SSH public key disclosure (.ssh/id_rsa.pub)
dirscan/system/pubkey.fixedSuggestion: Prohibit access to .ssh directories to prevent disclosure of server user information.

dirscan/temp/default.fixedSuggestion: Regularly clean up temporary files and configure servers to prohibit access to such extensions.

jsonp/jsonp/default.fixedSuggestion: Strictly validate Referer, avoid using JSONP to transmit sensitive data whenever possible, and switch to CORS instead.

path-traversal/path-traversal/default.fixedSuggestion: Filter traversal characters such as '../', use basename() to process file names, or validate file paths through whitelists.

redirect/redirect/default.fixedSuggestion: Validate redirect target URLs through whitelists and avoid directly using user-input URLs for redirection.

sqldet/blind-based/default.fixedSuggestion: Use prepared statements (Prepared Statements) or parameterized queries, and avoid SQL concatenation.

sqldet/error-based/default.fixedSuggestion: Use prepared statements and disable detailed database error information in production environments.

xss/reflected/default.fixedSuggestion: Strictly filter user input, HTML entity encode content output to pages, and enable CSP policies.
